links.outcome: Readability of chatbot patient-education responses on meniscal tears across three models, six readability indices
links.effect: GPT-4o gave the most readable content (p < 0.001) compared with Gemini 1.5 Flash and DeepSeek-V3; Gemini was more reliable, showing a reliability-readability trade-off. Absolute reading grade levels are not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: In contrast, GPT-4o consistently provided the most readable content (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks and compares the quality, reliability, and readability of three commercial LLMs answering patient questions about meniscal tears using expert clinician raters and readability metrics.
